title_en: Regulations on the Administration of Representative Offices of Foreign Law Firms in China

articles.content_en: Article 1 These Regulations are formulated in accordance with the provisions of the Lawyers Law of the People's Republic of China for the purpose of regulating the establishment of representative offices of foreign law firms in China and their legal services activities.

Article 2 These Regulations shall apply to the establishment of representative offices in China (hereinafter referred to as representative offices) by foreign law firms and the engagement in legal services activities.

Article 3 When engaging in legal services activities, a representative office and its representatives shall abide by the laws, regulations and rules of China, strictly observe the professional ethics and practice discipline of Chinese lawyers, and shall not harm the national security or social public interests of China.
Article 4 The legal services activities engaged in by a representative office and its representatives in accordance with the provisions of these Regulations shall be protected by Chinese laws.
Article 5 A foreign law firm shall bear civil liability for the legal services activities engaged in by its representative office and its representatives within the territory of China.

Article 6 The establishment of a representative office in China and the dispatch of representatives by a foreign law firm shall be subject to the permission of the judicial administration department of the State Council.
No foreign law firm, other foreign organization or individual may engage in legal services activities within the territory of China in the name of a consulting company or under any other name.

Article 9 The judicial administration department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government shall complete the examination within three months from the date of receipt of the application documents and materials, and shall submit the examination opinions together with the documents and materials to the judicial administration department of the State Council for review. The judicial administration department of the State Council shall make a decision within six months; for a representative office that is permitted to be established, it shall issue a practice license and issue practice certificates to its representatives; for those not permitted, it shall inform them in writing of the reasons.

Article 10 A representative office and its representatives may only commence the legal services activities specified in these Regulations after completing the registration formalities with the judicial administration department of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government where the representative office is domiciled, by presenting the practice license and practice certificates. The representative office and its representatives shall register once each year.
The judicial administration department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government shall complete the registration formalities within two days from the date of receipt of the registration application.
Article 11 A representative office shall, in accordance with the provisions of relevant laws and administrative regulations, handle the relevant tax, banking, foreign exchange and other formalities.

Article 12 Where a foreign law firm needs to change the name of the representative office or reduce the number of representatives, it shall, in advance, submit a written application signed by its principal person in charge and relevant documents and materials to the judicial administration department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government where the representative office is domiciled, which shall be subject to the approval of the judicial administration department of the State Council, and the practice certificates of the persons who are no longer acting as representatives shall be recovered.
Where a representative office merges, splits, or adds new representatives, the procedures for permission shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of these Regulations on the establishment procedures of representative offices.
Article 16 A representative office shall not employ Chinese practicing lawyers; the employed assistants shall not provide legal services to clients.
Article 18 A representative of a representative office shall not serve or concurrently serve as a representative in more than one representative office.

Article 19 The representatives of a representative office shall reside in China for not less than six months each year; if the period is less than six months, they shall not be registered for the following year.
Article 20 A representative office may charge fees to clients for engaging in legal services as specified in these Regulations. The fees collected must be settled within the territory of China.

Article 21 The judicial administration department of the State Council and the judicial administration departments of the people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall, according to their functions and duties, be responsible for the supervision and administration of representative offices and their representatives.

Article 23 The judicial administration department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government shall, when charging fees for registering a representative office and its representatives according to law and for conducting annual inspection of representative offices, strictly implement the same fee standards approved by the price administration department of the State Council for Chinese law firms and practicing lawyers, and all fees collected must be turned over to the national treasury.
When imposing administrative penalties of fines according to law, the judicial administration department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government shall, in accordance with the provisions of relevant laws and administrative regulations, separate the decision on fines from the collection of fines; all fines collected and illegal gains confiscated according to law must be turned over to the national treasury.

Article 24 Where a representative office or a representative endangers China's national security, public security, or social management order, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law in accordance with the provisions of the Criminal Law on crimes endangering national security, crimes endangering public security, or crimes disrupting social management order, and the judicial administration department of the State Council shall revoke the practice license of the representative office or the practice certificate of the representative; if the act does not constitute a criminal punishment, a public security penalty shall be imposed according to law, and the judicial administration department of the State Council shall revoke the practice license of the representative office or the practice certificate of the representative.

Article 25 Where a representative office or a representative violates the provisions of Article 15 of these Regulations and illegally engages in legal services activities or other profit-making activities, the judicial administration department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government shall order it to suspend operations within a time limit; if the circumstances are serious, the judicial administration department of the State Council shall revoke the practice license of the representative office or the practice certificate of the representative.
Where there is any illegal act listed in the preceding paragraph, the judicial administration department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government shall confiscate the illegal gains and impose a fine of not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 200,000 yuan on the chief representative and each other representative directly responsible.

Article 28 Where a representative office, upon cancellation, transfers property out of China before the debts are fully settled, the judicial administration department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government shall order the return of the transferred property for the settlement of debts; if the interests of others are seriously harmed, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law against its chief representative and other directly responsible persons in accordance with the provisions of the Criminal Law on the crime of concealing property; if the act does not constitute a criminal punishment, the judicial administration department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government shall impose a fine of not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 300,000 yuan on the representative office, and a fine of not less than 20,000 yuan but not more than 100,000 yuan on the chief representative and each other directly responsible person.

Article 29 Where a representative of a representative office provides false evidence, conceals facts, or threatens or induces others to provide false evidence or conceal facts, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law in accordance with the provisions of the Criminal Law on the crime of obstructing testimony, and the judicial administration department of the State Council shall revoke his or her practice certificate.

Article 30 Where a foreign law firm, a foreign lawyer, or any other foreign organization or individual, without authorization, engages in legal services activities within the territory of China, or where a representative office or representative whose practice permit has been revoked continues to engage in legal services activities within the territory of China, the judicial administration department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government shall ban it, confiscate the illegal gains, and impose a fine of not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 300,000 yuan.

Article 31 Where the practice license of a representative office is lawfully revoked, the foreign law firm to which the representative office belongs shall not apply to establish a representative office in China within five years; where the practice certificate of a representative of a representative office is lawfully revoked, that representative shall not serve as a representative of a representative office in China within five years.
Where a representative of a representative office is lawfully sentenced to a criminal penalty for endangering China's national security, public security, or social management order, the law firm to which the representative office that the representative belongs may not apply to establish a representative office in China again, and that representative shall be disqualified from serving as a representative of a representative office in China for life.

Article 34 The administrative measures for law firms from the separate customs territories of China to establish representative offices in the mainland shall be separately formulated by the judicial administration department of the State Council in accordance with the principles of these Regulations.

Article 35 These Regulations shall come into force as of January 1, 2002. The representative offices in China of foreign law firms that have been permitted by the judicial administration department of the State Council to commence trial operations, and representatives who have been permitted to practice on a trial basis, prior to the coming into force of these Regulations shall, within 90 days from the date of coming into force of these Regulations, re-apply for approval procedures in accordance with the provisions of these Regulations.
